items:
A work permit must be issued the maintenance staff should be qualified and 
 carry the suitable safety category
Wear the appropriate safety equipment as safety shoes, safety helmet
Switch off all CB's on the motor control center (MCC)

Connect a frequency 
 source and frequency meter to the turbine magnetic speed pickup (77NH) of the 
 analog I/O modules < AIO3 > and jumper the remaining pickups in parallel to 
 the first. Simulate HP turbine speed to < R > < S > and < T > 
 Note :
 It may be necessary to disconnect the magnetic pickup to prevent ioading down 
 the test oscillator signal.

Select "NORMAL" 
 display mode and observe the HP turbine speed TNH on the CRT

Adjust the frequency 
 source to 
 obtain frequency (HZ) equal to rated shaft speed (rpm) specified in the 
 control spec-setting (5089HZ).Verify TNH displayed is 100%

Adjust control gain 
 constant TNK H2 if necessary record the new value of the PROM constant (11590 
 CNT15).

Increase oscillator 
 frequency to 125% of rated shaft speed and verify that TNH displayed is 
 correct

Disconnect the test 
 oscillator and the test counter from the turbine magnetic speed pickups (77 
 NH) input of the analog I/O module < AIO3 > and disconnect the jumpers between 
 the remaining pickups and the first.

Reconnect the three 
 magnetic pickups (77 NH 1,2,3) inputs to the analog I/O module (AIO3)
